Professional Experience  
At NexGen Technologies, I developed cross-platform mobile applications for enterprise clients, focusing on user-centric design and performance optimization. My work involved integrating REST APIs to streamline data flow between frontend interfaces and backend systems, resulting in a 25% reduction in load times for internal tools. I collaborated with designers to ensure accessibility standards were met, particularly for legacy systems, which improved usability for users with visual impairments. Prior to this, as a Junior Mobile Developer at CodeCraft Studios, I contributed to a suite of React Native apps used by 15,000+ users monthly. My responsibilities included refactoring legacy code to improve maintainability and implementing Kotlin-based features for Android-specific enhancements. Earlier, as an intern at TechNova Solutions, I supported the development of a Flutter-based inventory management system, which reduced manual data entry errors by 18% through automated sync features.  

Technical Skills  
Flutter: Built scalable UI components for enterprise apps, leveraging its performance advantages over native solutions.  
Kotlin: Implemented Android-specific features, such as offline data caching, using coroutines and room database integration.  
REST API design: Collaborated with backend teams to define endpoints for a customer relationship management tool, ensuring secure and efficient data exchange.  
React Native: Developed reusable components for a mobile app used by 12,000+ users, emphasizing modular architecture for easier updates.  
Swift: Contributed to iOS-specific enhancements, including payment gateway integrations, by leveraging Swift’s memory management capabilities.  
Web accessibility (WCAG): Ensured compliance for a government-facing app, incorporating ARIA labels and semantic HTML to meet Level AA standards.  
React: Utilized in prototyping UI concepts for a project management tool, though primarily focused on native implementations for production.  
TypeScript: Applied in small-scale utility functions to enforce type safety in a React Native module.  

Summary  
With two years of hands-on experience in mobile development, I specialize in creating robust, accessible applications for enterprise environments. My work spans both native and cross-platform solutions, with a focus on improving user workflows and system efficiency. I thrive in collaborative settings, translating business requirements into technical specifications while maintaining high standards for code quality and accessibility.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of Technology, 2022. Graduated with honors, focusing on software engineering principles and mobile development frameworks.  

Projects  
1. **Enterprise Inventory Management System**: Developed using Flutter, this app streamlined supply chain operations for a logistics firm. Key features included real-time stock tracking and barcode scanning, reducing manual errors by 18%.  
2. **Customer Relationship Management Tool**: Designed and implemented REST API integrations for a CRM platform, enabling seamless data synchronization across web and mobile interfaces. The solution supported 50+ client accounts.  
3. **Accessibility-Enhanced Government App**: Redesigned a legacy mobile application to meet WCAG 2.1 standards, adding screen reader support and keyboard navigation. User feedback indicated a 30% increase in satisfaction post-launch.  
4. **Payment Gateway Integration**: Spearheaded the development of a secure payment module for an e-commerce app using Swift, reducing transaction failure rates by 12% through improved error handling.
